parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The order in which to evaluate this rule. Lower-ordered rules are evaluated first. Each rule MUST have a unique order value.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this ACL rule.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: A human-readable description of this ACL rule.

parameters.name: AllowAnonymous
parameters.description: If {{true}}, this rule allows access to anonymous clients.

parameters.name: ClientList
parameters.description: The MQTT client identity entries to which this rule applies. If this list is {{empty}}, the rule can apply to any client. Whether this rule also applies to anonymous clients is determined by this rule's {{param|AllowAnonymous}} parameter.

parameters.name: Topics
parameters.description: Each item specifies an MQTT topic filter to which this rule applies. The filter may include MQTT-standard wildcards (`+` for a single level, `#` for multiple levels). Some brokers may also support implementation-specific keywords. Refer to {{bibref|MQTT50|section 4.7}} for details on topic matching.

parameters.name: Operations
parameters.description: The MQTT operations that this rule controls. This parameter works in conjunction with {{param|Access}} to determine whether the specified operations are allowed or denied.

parameters.name: Access
parameters.description: Whether to allow or deny the operations specified in {{param|Operations}} on the configured {{param|Topics}}.

object.description: An entry in the Access Control List (ACL). Each entry specifies a single permission rule, defining which user or client can perform a specific operation (Publish or Subscribe) on a particular MQTT topic, and whether that action is allowed or denied.
